channel.title: Wiggle blog
channel.description: Guides for Wiggle, the early-access Mac assistant that appears when you shake the mouse.

item.title: What is Wiggle for Mac?
item.description: Wiggle is an early-access Mac app. Shake the mouse and an assistant appears at the cursor.

item.title: How to open Wiggle by shaking the mouse
item.description: Five quick back-and-forth strokes in under a second open Wiggle at the cursor. Slow moves do not.

item.title: Chat, screenshot, or voice
item.description: Each time Wiggle opens, you pick Chat, Screenshot, or Voice. Nothing is taken until you pick it.

item.title: Apple Intelligence, Ollama, or your own key
item.description: Wiggle can use Apple Intelligence, a local model through Ollama, or your own Claude or OpenAI key.

item.title: What happens when you use your own Claude or OpenAI key
item.description: A question you send with your own key goes to Claude or OpenAI. Apple Intelligence and Ollama stay on the Mac.

item.title: Does a Wiggle screenshot leave your Mac?
item.description: A screenshot happens when you choose Screenshot. It is not taken in the background, and it is not licensed to advertisers.

item.title: Does Wiggle listen all the time?
item.description: Voice is a mode you pick, like Chat or Screenshot. It is not an always-on microphone.

item.title: Wiggle does not ask you to make an account
item.description: There is no Wiggle account and no analytics in the product. Email is the only message this website receives.

item.title: Wiggle is in early access, and there is no price yet
item.description: There is no checkout on this site. Wiggle is in early access, and this site lists no price.
